name: Hypnotic Pattern

targets.description: each creature in the area that can see the pattern

summary: 30-foot Cube: creatures that see it make a Wisdom save or are Charmed, Incapacitated and at Speed 0.
text: A swirling pattern of colors flashes briefly in a 30-foot Cube within 120 feet, then vanishes. Each creature in the area that can see it makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it has the Charmed condition for the duration, and while Charmed this way it has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0. The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake it out of its daze.
